messages:
kim: scheduling cross-service patch tonight 23:00 UTC. targets: api:v2026-06-14.1, runtime:2.3.1, router:0.9.8, console:1.12.5. need quick final sign-off on pins and rollback rules.

noah: suggest pinning runtime:2.3.1 for hosted; keep dedicated at 2.3.0 for extra safety. fallback runtime:2.2.8 if kv churn.

olga: console change is a minor asset bump only. router has header propagation fix that should be safe. sequence proposed: api -> runtime -> router -> console.

kim: canary plan: 5% for 10m, 20% for 10m, then 100%. stagger 45s between services.

olga: rollback auto-triggers: API 5xx >0.6% for 5m OR p50 latency +80ms for 10m OR runtime OOMs/kv-evict >3x baseline. Manual abort: /deploy abort <run-id>.

noah: add console visual smoke watch (grep for `render_error`) and a DevEx @mention if function-tooling errors appear. kernel-quant path only in canary — watch tokenization diffs and KV miss-rate.

kim: pins set: runtime:2.3.1 (fallback 2.2.8), console:1.12.5, router:0.9.8, api tag:v2026-06-14.1.

deploy-bot: scheduled orchestrated deploy (run-id:20260614-03) by kim at 2026-06-14T23:00:00Z. Canary plan: [5% x10m,20% x10m,100%]. Auto-rollback thresholds applied.

pager-duty: on-call alerted for potential auto-rollbacks. will page if thresholds hit.

kim: running in ~15m. hold here to abort if needed.

olga: ready; I'll monitor console and router metrics.

noah: ready; will watch KV eviction and tokenization. prefer promoting fallback for runtime-only issues before aborting whole run.

deploy-bot: run 20260614-03: canary started for api and runtime. 5% traffic to new variants. Monitoring hooks live.

kim: thanks all — will collect notes for release_notes.md after run completes.
